subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron job organization use a freeform tags array, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or no new core cron classification field?
rationale: The requested field becomes persisted cron API/UI/CLI surface and overlaps reminders and plugin scheduling, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Adopt typed cron metadata
options.body: Define a small owner-reviewed cron classification/display metadata contract that can cover tags, reminders, and future plugin-created jobs without opaque drift.

options.title: Add freeform tags only
options.body: Implement the reporter's requested tags array directly, accepting the risk that reminders or plugin scheduling may later need a second metadata model.

options.title: Keep names only
options.body: Decline new core cron classification surface and keep organization as name/description conventions until a narrower product need is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Adopt typed cron metadata
recommendation.body: Define a small owner-reviewed cron classification/display metadata contract that can cover tags, reminders, and future plugin-created jobs without opaque drift.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest prior API/protocol design signal on the closed opaque cron metadata PR.
